notes.title: 🎬 New Trailer + Demo Release Date!🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋


We’re happy to share our brand-new trailer and announce the demo release date - September 24! 🎉Woohoo!

[previewyoutube="xifKaCY0jyE;full"][/previewyoutube]


We’re finishing the last little tweaks to bring you the best experience we can!



This is our first PC project, and we’re pouring lots of love into it. Every update is a big milestone for us, and your joy is the best reward - it makes all the sleepless nights worth it!



It would mean a lot to hear your thoughts on the trailer and the new location we’re showing!



There’s much more waiting for you in the demo! 🚀



- The Space Sauce Team
